user.title: Timed Event
user.description: Adds a timer button to every entity's more-info dialog. Reload the browser after setup.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Timed Event is already set up.

schedule.name: Schedule timed action
schedule.description: Run an action on an entity after a delay or at a time, optionally repeating.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Run after this delay (use either delay or at). With repeat: interval.

at.name: At
at.description: Run at this date and time (use either delay or at). With repeat: every day at this time.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Repeat every delay interval, or daily when at is used.

cancel.name: Cancel timed action
cancel.description: Cancel a pending timed action by ID, or all pending actions of an entity.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: ID of the timer to cancel.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Cancel all timers of this entity.
